items.title: Merck’s TROP2 ADC extends overall survival in pivotal gastroesophageal cancer trial

Experiences of Care in Advanced Liver Disease
items.summary: Researchers from Bournemouth University have published research looking at experiences of care in advanced liver disease. People with liver disease, carers (such as family members) and healthcare professionals were involved. They shared what worked well, what could be better, and suggested ways of improving care.

items.title: Liver UK joins call for safer health information in the age of AI
items.summary: AI tools have the potential to help people find health information and improve their care. But there are worries about the risk of misinformation. Liver UK has joined other top health charities to urge the government to act. We want to make sure everyone can find reliable, evidence-based health information online.
